risks.name: chat knowledge monopoly
risks.failure: material state exists only in conversation

risks.name: novelty drift
risks.failure: new aspect becomes a new priority or architecture direction because it is new

risks.name: accretion
risks.failure: new files, concepts, layers or stores are appended instead of integrated

risks.name: plausibility becomes truth
risks.failure: convincing AI output is silently treated as accepted state

risks.name: authority creep
risks.failure: AI implicitly takes owner or specialist decisions
mitigation: PR review gate for material promotion

risks.name: solutionism
risks.failure: technology or framework is chosen before need and fit are established

risks.name: over-modeling
risks.failure: meta-system complexity grows faster than domain value

risks.name: false completion
risks.failure: green CI or closed issue is mistaken for domain/product success
mitigation: separate deterministic verification, domain review and owner acceptance

risks.name: self-reinforcing error
risks.failure: earlier AI interpretation is later reused as if it were independent evidence

risks.name: technical blind spot
risks.failure: problem owner cannot see missing ML/data/backend/security/ops concerns
